trust_decision.summary: Whether an LLM-supplied file_path/dir_path in the file tools stays inside the configured curr_dir; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: each handler only chdir()s into curr_dir and passes the raw path to the system.py helpers.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'the file tools'. ReadFileTool.handle is the first handler in that file, and its comment 'ASSUME: file_path should be relative to the curr_dir' (line 58) states the missing invariant.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The whole fix sits in the three handlers in one file plus a new helper. The lower-level helpers create_file/read_file/list_dir (langroid/utils/system.py:190-287) are left unguarded.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The ~ expansion in read_file (langroid/utils/system.py:252) runs only after an exists() check on the unexpanded path (line 250), so '~/x' looks harmless unless a literal '~' directory exists. A solver will argue that is an unreachable corner, even though WriteFileTool can create that directory itself (create_file mkdirs the parent without expansion, langroid/utils/system.py:206-207).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Relative paths into subdirectories ('subdir/file2.py', 'sub/inside.txt') and '.' must still read, write (with parent mkdir) and list. The write must still be git-committed via a path relative to curr_dir. Subclassing with a custom _curr_dir staticmethod must keep working, as must the 'File not found' and 'empty' messages. An over-broad fix (rejecting any '/', or forcing absolute paths into git_commit_file) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: in-tree symlink pointing outside, via Path.resolve() (fix.diff:83-84, fix.diff:139-149)
'..' as a bare dir_path for list (fix.diff:163-170)

O7_producer.where: curr_dir comes from a caller-supplied get_curr_dir callable (langroid/agent/tools/file_tools.py:23-44); no schema, serializer or config loader produces the path

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Parser differential: the check resolves the path without expanduser, but read_file later expands '~' and reads the real home path once a literal '~' directory exists under curr_dir (WriteFileTool can create one).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The exists() check on the unexpanded path makes '~' look unreachable; the published tests never cover '~'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (langroid/utils) from the landing point (langroid/agent/tools)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Check-then-use gap: the fix calls safe_resolve_path, throws the resolved path away, and then hands the raw string to create_file/read_file/list_dir, so the guard and the sink parse the path separately.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The same string relative to the same chdir looks equivalent; it only differs through expansion or a symlink swapped in between.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An EditFileTool/AppendFileTool (create_file with if_exists='append') or a DiffFileTool built on diff_files (langroid/utils/system.py:261) in a second module, e.g. langroid/agent/tools/code_tools.py
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: system.py already exposes the 'append' mode and diff_files with no in-tree tool using them; a maintainer would naturally wrap them with the same create(get_curr_dir) pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A GitRestoreFileTool/GitDiffFileTool taking an LLM-supplied file_path into git_restore_file/git_diff_file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: git_utils already offers these helpers next to git_commit_file, which WriteFileTool uses; a git-aware tool set is a plausible extension in another package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Keep or extend the expanduser-after-check differential in read_file (and add the same to list_dir)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Expanding '~' is a convenience a helper author adds without thinking of the tool sandbox.

O9_family: path traversal (CWE-22/23): file read/write/list escape from a configured base directory

O10_build.project_tests: tests/main/test_file_tools.py: the existing tests drive an LLM agent (need an API key); the fix's regression tests call handle() directly and run offline

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject paths that contain '..' or start with '/' in ReadFileTool.handle only (misses absolute-via-symlink, '~' expansion, and the write/list tools)

out_of_scope_notes: langroid/utils/system.py:286 ListDirTool lets NotADirectoryError from list_dir propagate (no handler) - robustness, not this advisory.
